name: United States (34 stars, 1861–1863)
description: Thirteen alternating red and white stripes with a navy canton bearing thirty-four white stars in staggered rows.
history: The Union flag at the outbreak of the Civil War, adopted on 4 July 1861 after Kansas's admission. President Lincoln refused to remove stars for the seceded states, so all thirty-four remained through the war's first years; a thirty-fifth was added for West Virginia in 1863.
